text:
maria: Proposal: a minimal "hint shim" so adapters can be SLA-aware without changing policy semantics. tiny, versioned hint payload from compiler to runtime -> adapters consume.

kevin: Nice. Minimal contract please. Example?

maria: `{"hint_v":1,"p99_ms":200,"cost_per_m":0.001,"regions":["us-east","eu"]}`. Keep it optional.

li: Adapters must support legacy mode. Hinted mode uses hint + local profile to score candidates and returns ordered list.

anita: Response shape suggestion: `{"candidates":[{"id":"ded-a","score":0.78,"uncertainty":0.18,"why":"p99 OK"}],"meta":"probe=15m","cid":"r-abc"}`. Uncertainty handles cold-starts/tails.

maria: Rollout plan: 1) compile emits hints (no runtime change) 2) adapter shim reads hints in sim-only mode and logs to hint-sim stream 3) parity sims against traces 4) canary flip for small tenant set if metrics look good.

kevin: Telemetry: every decision needs `cid` to join probe metrics. Add alerts: p99 delta, cost delta, decision drift.

li: Security: hints are control-plane only, encrypted at rest, stripped from user logs.

anita: Open questions to capture in RFC appendix: how to compute uncertainty, select_threshold defaults, profile refresh cadence. I'll own sim harness.

maria: 48-hour RFC draft window, then 30m sync. Thumbs?

kevin: +1

li: +1

anita: +1

ops-bot: created ticket #ops/adapter-hints and scheduled meeting.
